name: Fulbright Degree Program (Master's and PhD)
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP) under Fulbright policies and regulations
eligible_institutions: Universities all over the United States
fields_of_study: All academic disciplines are eligible, except clinical medicine.
domicile_requirements: Pakistani citizens with strong academic histories, residing (throughout the process) in Pakistan and committed to returning and serving Pakistan
merit_criteria: The Graduate Record Examination (GRE General) is required for all applicants. Under the new scoring system, a minimum score of 145 is required on each section of the GRE examination, with a higher score on the section most applicable to your field of study.
other_conditions: Eligible Master's applicants will have a four-year Bachelor's degree or a Bachelor's and Master's combination (16 years of formal education) and PhD applicants will have Master's, M.Phil., or a comparable degree (18 years of formal education) from an accredited university. Recent graduates are encouraged to apply, except for MBA and Public Policy/Administration applicants, who require 2 years of work experience in the relevant field. Ineligible persons include those with dual U.S./Pakistan nationality or those having a spouse, or child over 18 years of age who is a U.S. citizen or permanent resident, employees/contractors of Fulbright, U.S. State Dept, or USAID and their families, people who already availed one scholarship award for any Fulbright program, and persons already studying in the U.S. or on a work/residence/student visa in any country.
benefits: Tuition, required textbooks, airfare, a living stipend, and health insurance.
application_procedure: An application with references and required supporting documents must be submitted online. Paper applications will not be accepted.
required_documents: An application form, three reference letters, GRE score report, scanned transcripts including an explanation of the grading scale.
attestation_requirements: HEC-attested documents are preferable with the application but degree and transcripts attested by the issuing authority will be acceptable at the time of application. High school and post-secondary diplomas or certificates do not need to be officially verified/attested.
evidence_quote: Deadline April 1, 2026

name: Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship
sponsor: United States Educational Foundation in Pakistan (USEFP)
eligible_institutions: Approximately 18 campuses have been selected through a competitive process to host fellows
merit_criteria: competitive process based on their potential for leadership and commitment to Public service in the public or private sector
other_conditions: Applicants must be Pakistani citizens with 8-18 years of progressively responsible professional/work experience, coupled with 16 years of education (4 year Bachelor's or 2 year Bachelor's and a Master's degree) and a guarantee of re-employment upon return to Pakistan. Ineligible: university teachers or researchers with no management experience, those who attended graduate school in the U.S. in the last seven years or who have had long-term U.S. experience within the last five years, dual U.S./Pakistan nationality, or having a spouse, parent or child over 18 who is a U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
benefits: Tuition, airfare, textbooks, a living stipend, and health insurance.
application_procedure: Online applications only.
required_documents: Duolingo Test Score Report (or valid iBT TOEFL or IELTS test score), medical history and examination form, scanned copy of valid passport and No objection certificate (NOC) from employer / government of Pakistan (for finalists).
evidence_quote: The Hubert H. Humphrey Fellowship Program brings accomplished mid-career professionals with demonstrated leadership potential to the United States for a year of graduate-level non-degree academic coursework and professional development activities.
